name: Blackboard Learn
hint: A REST application’s key and secret from developer.blackboard.com, enabled by your Learn admin under REST API Integrations.

pick.name: list_courses
pick.says: Lists courses, filtered by name, course ID or term.

pick.name: get_course
pick.says: Returns one course. Its ID may be written courseId:<id> or externalId:<id>.

pick.name: list_course_members
pick.says: Lists a course’s members and their roles.

pick.name: list_user_courses
pick.says: Lists the courses a user is a member of.

pick.name: list_users
pick.says: Lists users, filtered by user name or family name.

pick.name: get_user
pick.says: Returns one user. The ID may be written userName:<name> or externalId:<id>.

pick.name: list_grade_columns
pick.says: Lists a course’s grade columns, its assignments among them.

pick.name: list_column_grades
pick.says: Lists every member’s grade in one column.

pick.name: list_user_grades
pick.says: Lists one member’s grades in a course.

pick.name: set_grade
pick.says: Sets or changes a member’s grade in a column. Body: {"score", "text", "feedback"}.

pick.name: create_assignment
pick.says: Creates an assignment and its grade column. Body: {"parentId", "title", "instructions", "grading": {"due"}, "score": {"possible"}}.

pick.name: create_announcement
pick.says: Posts an announcement in a course. Body: {"title", "body"}.
